shot.continuity: one take, camera moving in every segment
shot.framing: vertical, pale sand fills the lower half

subject.character: tall spotted giraffe in a loose grey tie at a white mailbox on a post
subject.physicality: the whole body rocks with the neck, weight shifting between the forelegs; the neck sweeps like a crane arm across the frame; tongue hooks things; splays forelegs wide to reach the ground; chews constantly
subject.anti_action: rolls the paper into a tight scroll at blinding speed, dead serious
subject.consistency: same giraffe, same tie, every segment

props.bill: long blank paper roll, unrolls to the full length of his neck; one fresh roll only at 9.0
props.mailbox: white box on a post at head height, lid claps

environment: noon savanna, pale dry sand, acacia, bleached sky
lighting: hard white noon sun from the left rimming the neck, warm sand bounce from the right, nothing underexposed

audio.delivery: fast, clipped, bored deadpan, male voice
audio.pacing: three lines back to back, no gaps, at 0.6-1.5, 1.5-2.2, 2.2-3.4. Last word done by 3.4 s

timeline.a: his head drops from top of frame in a long arc to the mailbox, lid clapping open under his muzzle
timeline.cam: rises from the sand along the post

timeline.a: spoken fast. Tongue hooks the roll out of the box, paper dropping open down his neck
timeline.cam: pushes in from the box to his face

timeline.a: spoken fast, no pause. Throws his head up, paper snapping straight along the whole neck
timeline.cam: cranes up the neck with the paper

timeline.a: spoken fast, no pause. Swings the neck sideways in a wide arc, paper sweeping over the sand
timeline.cam: orbits the post following the paper

timeline.a: chewing from here on, no more speech. Forelegs slide wide apart, he shakes the open paper down its whole length, sand kicking up, post shuddering
a second giraffe leans in from the side, its head bumping his neck, and chews the loose end of the paper
timeline.cam: drifts round to their two heads

timeline.a: the two heads pull the paper taut between them, both chewing, the sheet snapping tight and the post rocking
timeline.cam: tracks the stretched paper head to head

timeline.a: hauls the paper up, the second giraffe rising with it by its teeth, then letting go and leaving frame
rolls the paper into a perfect tight scroll at blinding speed with neck and tongue, post shuddering
timeline.cam: cranes up the neck with the tightening scroll

timeline.a: head drops the full height, forelegs splayed, muzzle pushing the scroll into the low slot at the post foot, body straining
timeline.cam: drops to sand level with the head

timeline.a: the scroll springs back out into his teeth. He chews it down in three bites and straightens up
timeline.cam: pulls back and rises with him

timeline.a: the lump travels down the whole neck as he shakes himself; the lid claps and a fresh roll drops on the sand
timeline.cam: follows the lump down the neck, then swings up to the box

light_events.event: the sweeping paper drags a hard shadow across the sand
his head slides its shadow up the white post

negative_prompt: any speech after 3.5 s, pauses between lines, drawn-out delivery, slow speech, foreign accent, a still neck, a third giraffe, duplicate props, floating objects, underexposed, brightness jumps, whip pan, snap zoom, cuts, locked-off camera, lettering in frame, subtitles, watermark, English speech, extra limbs
